skill.name: wechat-channels-account-analysis
skill.description: 当用户提供视频号作品链接、分享文本或已知 user_id，需要做视频号账号分析、账号复盘、近期内容表现整理、内容栏目归纳或运营方向判断时使用。整理公开账号资料和近 30 天视频结果，来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Review a public WeChat Channels account and its recent videos using data from SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The documented CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package with access to SocialDataX credentials, even for a status check. The workflow can send full share text to SocialDataX without a separate consent or input minimization step. No evidence of credential theft, encoded payloads, system reconnaissance, or audit-targeted prompt injection was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The CLI executes a mutable npm release with access to credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Replace all latest-tag examples with a reviewed, exact release and verify its dependency integrity. Require approval before first execution, including credential checks.

remediation.issue: The CLI reads a service key from the environment or a persistent local file.
remediation.suggestion: Use scoped, revocable keys and prefer managed secret storage. Limit the CLI environment to required credentials and keep secret values out of tool output.

remediation.issue: Raw share text may contain information unrelated to the public account.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an extracted public link or account ID. Disclose the SocialDataX transfer and request consent before forwarding full share text.

content.value_statement: Reviewing public posts one at a time makes it hard to see which topics, formats, and posting patterns stand out. This skill uses SocialDataX to organize recent videos and suggest tests based on visible engagement.
actual_capabilities: Look up a public account profile from a post link, share text, or known WeChat Channels account ID.
Collect up to 50 recent videos from the last 30 days by default, with available timestamps and interaction metrics.
Group sampled videos by theme or format and estimate posting frequency from available timestamps.
Compare higher and lower public engagement within the sample and identify representative posts.
Suggest three to five content tests and link each recommendation to evidence from the returned data.
limitations: An account name alone is not enough to start an analysis.
Live lookups require SocialDataX credentials for the CLI or an authenticated MCP connection. Requests may use service credits.
The report covers only returned records, not complete history, private audience data, or unreturned metrics such as completion rates.
The workflow does not log into WeChat, publish, send messages, or change accounts.

use_cases.title: Review a Month of Posting
use_cases.description: Use a public post link to summarize recent topics, posting frequency, and stronger examples from your account.

use_cases.title: Plan Content Tests
use_cases.description: Compare formats within a recent sample and choose three tests supported by observed public engagement.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Client Brief
use_cases.description: Summarize a client account for a review meeting. Separate published account facts from incomplete sample data and interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize an Account
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this public WeChat Channels post link: [link]. Summarize the account and its recent videos. Mark missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Group Recent Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Review WeChat Channels account [account ID] for the last 14 days. Group videos by topic, count each group, and summarize the posting schedule.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Public Engagement
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this public post link: [link]. Compare public engagement by video format. Give a representative post from each group and flag any missing metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design the Next Content Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to 40 videos from the last 30 days for [account ID]. Propose three tests with supporting posts, success measures, and any sample limits.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review the last 30 days using a public post link.
output: Sample: 16 videos returned. Eight were tutorials, five showed products, and three answered common questions.
Posting cadence: Most weeks had three or four posts. Two missing timestamps limit this estimate.
Test: Publish two short tutorials and compare their public comment counts after seven days.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Compare formats for a known account ID.
output: Public engagement: Three of the five videos with the most visible likes were demonstrations.
Coverage: Pagination stopped after 18 videos. The result does not describe the complete period.
Test: Compare a demonstration with a question-and-answer video on the same topic. Record visible likes and comments after seven days.

best_practices: Use a public post link or a known account ID instead of forwarding full share text.
Use an approved SocialDataX connection and keep API keys out of chat and reports.
State the date range and sample size. Mark missing metrics and partial results.
anti_patterns: Requesting a lookup by display name alone.
Pasting an API key or private notes into a prompt or share text.
Treating public interactions as proof of audience retention, recommendation ranking, or future growth.

faq.question: What input can I use?
faq.answer: Provide a public WeChat Channels post link, share text, or known account ID. A public link avoids sharing any extra text.

faq.question: How many videos does the skill review?
faq.answer: The default is up to 50 videos from the last 30 days. You can request a different range or smaller sample.

faq.question: Where does the data come from?
faq.answer: SocialDataX retrieves public profile and video records through its CLI or an authenticated MCP connection. A lookup sends the supplied account input to that provider.

faq.question: Do I need to share my API key in chat?
faq.answer: No. Use an approved authenticated connection or configure credentials locally. Do not put the key in your prompt.

faq.question: What happens if the lookup stops before it finishes?
faq.answer: The skill keeps returned records and marks the sample as incomplete. It can resume from a valid next-page token after the error is resolved.

faq.question: Can the skill access private metrics or publish posts?
faq.answer: No. The workflow analyzes returned public data and does not log into WeChat, publish posts, or modify accounts.
